summary: A Quote subscription on an NSE equity: Shoonya's touchline snapshot (tk) gives a Quote frame with every quote field, a partial update (tf) overlays it and its zero open keeps the cached one, and after the unsubscribe a frame still in flight reaches nobody.

notes: Noren's feed time ft goes out as the member's timestamp key in seconds, as on the web; its trade time ltt (HH:MM:SS) is not copied as text, and the Noren family sends no ltt key (docs/port/market-data-frames.md; audit FB-07).

deviations.reason: The web's Shoonya adapter forwards Noren's ltt as text (HH:MM:SS), or null when the frame has none; feed times are epoch milliseconds (docs), and a text copy of a time is not sent (docs/port/market-data-frames.md). The Noren family sends no ltt key (feed/dialect/names.rs).

The web's Shoonya adapter sends Noren's pc as percent_change only, with no price_change keys; the desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent beside percent_change. Lead ruling 2026-11-09: the Noren members turn the canonical change keys off and keep percent_change, by lane wire's per-broker key rule (pending).

Noren's touchline carries the book totals (tbq, tsq), and the web's Shoonya Quote dict drops them: lost data. The desktop keeps them (lead decision: data a web adapter drops from a mode is kept).
